entities.summary: Gustaf Adolf Montgomery (1790–1861) was a Finnish colonel. Born in Finland before the separation of the Grand Duchy of Finland from Sweden, he was old enough to take part in the Finnish War (1808–09) on the losing Swedish/Finnish side. He served as an adjutant in the army of general Carl Johan Adlercreutz.
